title: The same near-miss, on a tree that happens to be only one level deep
prompt: What does this return? Read it — do not run it.

explanation.approach: This is why the bug ships: on a flat tree `o.l` and `o.r` already are numbers, so skipping the recursive call is invisible until a deeper tree arrives.
